fields.title: Find the anomaly
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: In the Polka schema, the store name is duplicated in every order for reporting speed. Name three specific consequences and determine whether this is duplication or a snapshot.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: duplication, not a snapshot — store name is a single fact that must match everywhere, unlike the purchase price. Consequences: renaming requires updating hundreds of thousands of records; a partial failure leaves two names for the same store; searching by name yields conflicting results. Check: if a value must change along with the original — it's duplication; if it must stay as it was — it's a snapshot.
